北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京朋友们，天晴但体感很冷哦，注意保暖，别冻着了！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing friends, it's sunny but feels very cold. Stay warm and don't catch a chill!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪有雾，能见度低，出门慢行。天冷湿润，小心着凉！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is foggy with low visibility, please drive carefully. It's cold and damp, watch out for colds!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海多云，体感微凉。记得添衣，保持好心情哦！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to layer up and stay cheerful!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光好，但湿度大，早晚温差大，别忘了添减衣物。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny but humid. Mind the temperature difference between day and night, dress accordingly.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阳光正好，体感舒适。但湿度高，记得多喝水哦。
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny and comfortable. High humidity, remember to drink more water!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州天晴，但体感稍冷，风力 2 级。出门加件外套哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is sunny but feels a bit cold with a level 2 wind. Bring an extra jacket!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低，体感 0℃。出行注意安全，保暖防潮。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with low visibility, feels like 0℃. Stay safe and keep warm and dry.

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都天晴但体感 0℃ 以下，湿度 100%。注意保暖防寒哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny but feels below 0℃ with 100% humidity. Keep warm and prevent chills!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阳光暖暖，体感稍凉。记得添衣，别忘了享受阳光。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is sunny and warm, but feels a bit cool. Remember to layer up and enjoy the sunshine.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安天晴但很冷，体感 -2℃。出门务必多穿，小心着凉！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny but very cold, feels like -2℃. Dress warmly when going out, watch out for colds!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，能见度低，湿度高。出行注意安全，当心湿滑。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with low visibility and high humidity. Stay safe and be careful of slippery roads.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨极寒，体感 -30℃。一定要裹严实，千万别冻伤！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is extremely cold, feels like -30℃. Bundle up tightly to avoid frostbite!
哈尔滨.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -30℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳天晴，但体感 -20℃ 且风力 3 级。防寒保暖是关键！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny but feels -20℃ with a level 3 wind. Keeping warm is essential!
沈阳.alert: 🥶 红色极寒警报：体感低至 -20℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明有雾，体感湿冷，能见度低。出行注意安全，别着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is foggy, feels damp and cold with low visibility. Stay safe and don't catch a cold.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门有雾，能见度不高，风力 2 级。出门小心，注意交通安全。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is foggy with low visibility and a level 2 wind. Be careful when going out, mind traffic safety.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有霾，体感 -3℃ 且风力 3 级。注意防护，做好保暖。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is hazy, feels like -3℃ with a level 3 wind. Protect yourself and keep warm.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 -14℃。风力 2 级。添衣保暖，注意防风！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and feels like -14℃ with a level 2 wind. Layer up and protect against the wind!
